subject: Further Information Requested — Proposal CPI/2026/00512
body:
Proposal Number: CPI/2026/00512
Insured: Suryodaya Petrochem Industries Pvt. Ltd.
Broker: Vikram Risk & Insurance Advisors LLP

Dear Vikram Risk & Insurance Advisors LLP,

Following review of Proposal CPI/2026/00512 (Suryodaya Petrochem Industries Pvt. Ltd.), the following is required before a final decision can be issued:
  - Review by Chief Underwriting Officer

Regards,
Underwriting Team, Commercial Property Division
reason: The Total Insured Value (TIV) of INR 940,00,00,000 significantly exceeds my delegated authority and requires review by the Chief Underwriting Officer. The case presents several high-risk factors including chemical manufacturing processes, storage of flammable liquids, aged electrical wiring, and a high catastrophe exposure (flood and seismic zones). While the human underwriter's assessment correctly identified these risks and applied appropriate loadings, the TIV necessitates a higher level of review.
